$comment: The repository root global.json pins SDK 11.0.100-preview.7, which is correct for the
shipping net11.0-tizen11.0 target. The validation lane deliberately builds the
behaviourBaseline framework net9.0-tizen7.0, whose Samsung workload is the only one
Samsung has actually published, so it pins its own SDK band here.
The .NET CLI resolves global.json from the working directory upward, which is why
run-validation-lane.sh changes into this folder before building.
